axes: glTF Y-up, 1 unit = 1 tile (= 1 m, player 1.85 tall)
colour: authored sRGB used as-is, roughness 1, metallic 0, no textures

frames.grip: origin = hand grip; same frame as gear_models_v1 templates + EquipBuilder specs; `grip` = the spec palm point (mesh-local glTF); `legacy` = quaternion into the old world_gear.js builder frame; `lay` = quaternion that lays it flat for drops / icons
frames.bind: rigid parts authored in the bind pose of assets/models/holm_kit_v2.glb; every child mesh has extras.bone
frames.skin: v2: a mesh skinned to the kit skeleton (glTF skin, 23 mixamorig joints, the kit rest pose) with the kit's own vertex weights; the runtime rebinds it to the player's skeleton and copies the kit's morph influences

bodies: eq_<kind> = body A, eq_<kind>_B = body B (extras.body); a kind without a _B template serves both
hides: extras.hides = the kit slots the item replaces (HolmKit hides them; Hair -> the bald head)
